title: POST-H-032-A - Agent capability inventory and promotion criteria
summary: Approves POST-H-032 and adds a local read-only governed agent capability inventory plus promotion criteria for deterministic, model-aware, RAG-aware, memory-aware, tool-calling and multiagent maturity paths.
limitations: Implemented-initial inventory/promotion governance only; it does not enable new runtime agent autonomy.
LLM, RAG, memory, tool calling, MCP and multiagent promotions require later POST-H-032 micro-sprints and negative tests.
External API provider usage remains disabled by default and requires a later ADR/pilot.
pass_criteria: All MIASI agents appear in the inventory.
Implemented agents have implementation modules and focal tests.
Agents with tools declare allowlists and all allowlisted tools exist in MIASI Tool Registry.
LLM/model-aware agents declare provider modes while mock remains default and external APIs remain disabled.
RAG candidates declare groundedness eval requirements while rag_enabled remains false in POST-H-032-A.
Memory candidates declare policy requirements while memory_enabled remains false in POST-H-032-A.
No agent has external_api_allowed, connector_write_enabled, plugin_execution_enabled, remote_execution_enabled or source_mutation_allowed by default.
block_criteria: Tool allowlist references unknown MIASI tools.
Memory enabled by default before POST-H-032-E ADR/policy.
Remote execution, connector write or plugin execution enabled.
risks: Agent inventory can become stale if MIASI agent registry changes without regenerating POST-H-032-A artifacts.
Promotion targets are advisory until later POST-H-032 micro-sprints add executable gates.
Tool allowlists are classified but tool-call execution enforcement remains POST-H-032-F scope.
